generation_method: Checkpoint tensor-to-shard mapping comes from model.safetensors.index.json; LFS SHA-256 values come from resolved Hugging Face blob filenames. No tensor contents or weights are copied into release evidence.

lookup_abi.chunk_contract: 128 logical rows per device prefill staging wave; public non-aligned tails are padded, masked, and sliced internally
lookup_abi.lookup_contract: torch.unique deduplicates each exact batched request, then per-shard index_select gathers only misses from safetensors mmap handles

runtime_defaults.mmap_policy: safetensors checkpoint shards remain mmap-backed; selected PLE rows only
runtime_defaults.pcie_assumption: direct owner-rank H2D plus exact non-owner zero D2D on one P300 board
runtime_defaults.pinned_host_staging: unavailable in torch 2.11.0+cpu on this host; contiguous CPU rows are handed to TT runtime staging
